chunks: Will be gathered together on a certain day which is predetermined.

key_terms.لَمَجْمُوعُونَ: Will be gathered (passive verb indicating resurrection)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the 'predetermined day' in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ya-Sin is often linked to the concept of *Yawm al-Ma'rifah* (the Day of Recognition), where the divine decree is irrevocably fixed. It underscores the inevitability of the *Qiyamah* and serves as a reminder that the gathering is not merely physical but a spiritual reckoning before the Imam of the Age or the Prophet himself.
